affected_subject.reason: increaseTokenBalance() in DistributionCreator.sol and its balance crediting are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Depositing fee-on-transfer tokens via increaseTokenBalance triggers the mismatch.

direct_effect.reason: Full amount credited while fewer tokens received, creating recorded balance exceeding holdings.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Conservation relation: recorded balances should not exceed actual holdings; insolvency and withdrawal shortfall derive expected-vs-actual mismatch.

summary: Report identifies the function, FoT deposit trigger, balance inflation effect, and a conservation/insolvency safety relation, sufficient to attempt formalization.
